description: This file contains a Sass mixin function 'generate-utility' used for generating utility CSS classes with customizable properties, values, states, and responsiveness options. It appears to facilitate dynamic creation of CSS utility classes, including support for CSS variables, RTL (right-to-left) variations, and media queries.

methods.name: generate-utility
methods.description: A Sass mixin function that dynamically generates utility CSS classes based on provided parameters such as utility map, infix for class names, and media query flags. It handles various property types, CSS variables, RTL support, states, and responsive RFS values.
